name: 侠客英雄传III
group_note: 侠客英雄传 II/III ("欢乐天地", 五邑无尽豪情), a Jin Yong-novel/European-medieval/comic-book crossover setting. WASM pass fixed the classic §8.1 GBK-byte-range is_chinese() bug in TWO places: adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc's is_chinese() (the real implementation CHINESE_D delegates to -- checked only str[0]'s raw byte range and required an even total length, always failing under UTF8 codepoint indexing) and adm/daemons/logind.lpc's own check_legal_name() (i%2 parity gate plus a byte-count length bound of 2-12, meant to be 1-6 characters per the user-facing '1 到 6 个中文字' message). Rewrote chinesed.lpc's is_chinese() to a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff loop and fixed check_legal_name() to check every character via CHINESE_D->is_chinese(name[i..i]) with the length bound corrected to 1-6. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot, confirmed via source; wiz_levels tops out at (admin)). Registration flow verified end-to-end across several WASM client sessions: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gender (m/f) -> race selection (0-5) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands, zero unexpected errors. Testing note: gender/race selection landed right after /std/char.lpc's heavy first-time compile burst (loading feature/damage.lpc, feature/skill.lpc etc.), causing the same kind of test-harness timing race documented on xhcii -- 'm' was occasionally swallowed as unrecognized regardless of --idle; padding with a duplicate 'm'/'0' send reliably got past it, and this is a client-timing artifact, not a mudlib defect (confirmed by a fully clean run showing zero caught exceptions in the registration path). Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with fluffos listed in the top tier. LPC formatter run across all 3178 .lpc files (3145 written, 12 errors, 21 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no map.lpc files present in this snapshot. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
